# Quaternius P10.5 character sources

Selected on 2026-10-18 from the author's official pages. All four packs are released under CC0; the original license and readme files are retained in `Licenses/`.

- **Universal Base Characters**, Quaternius, Standard download: <https://quaternius.com/packs/universalbasecharacters>
  - Selected files: female/male base FBX models and the eye, hair and regular-body base-colour textures.
  - Project use: CC0-derived head/eye meshes rebound to the matching outfit skeleton so role characters retain one humanoid Animator.

- **Modular Character Outfits — Fantasy**, Quaternius, Standard download: <https://quaternius.com/packs/modularcharacteroutfitsfantasy.html>
  - Selected files: female/male Peasant and Ranger FBX models plus their base-colour textures.
  - Project use: profession/work and military role presentation.
- **Universal Animation Library**, Quaternius, Standard download: <https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html>
  - Selected file: `UAL1_Standard.fbx`.
  - Project use: authored locomotion/action candidates.
- **Universal Animation Library 2**, Quaternius, Standard download: <https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary2.html>
  - Selected file: `UAL2_Standard.fbx`.
  - Project use: authored harvest, carry, woodcutting and combat actions.

Only the source files required by P10.5 are imported. The ignored acquisition archives remain under `Artifacts/P105/` and are not runtime dependencies.
